mvvCards.title: Ethical Research Standards
mvvCards.desc: All research publications follows strict ethical guidelines approved by our Institutional Ethics Committee (IEC), ensuring patient safety, data privacy, and scientific integrity.

mvvCards.title: Collaborative Research
mvvCards.desc: LIDS encourages inter-departmental and inter-institutional collaboration, with active partnerships with hospitals, universities, and research bodies across India.

mvvCards.title: Publication & Recognition
mvvCards.desc: Faculty and students are encouraged to publish in peer-reviewed journals. LIDS supports research grants, conference attendance, and recognizes outstanding contributions annually.
